question: Analyze the average percentage change in sales between the 12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020, for each attribute type: region, platform, age band, demographic, and customer type. For each attribute type, calculate the average percentage change in sales across all its attribute values. Identify the attribute type with the highest negative impact on sales and provide its average percentage change in sales.
sql:
WITH week_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        week_number,
        region,
        platform,
        age_band,
        demographic,
        customer_type,
        SUM(sales) as weekly_sales
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020
    GROUP BY week_number, region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type
),
region_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number <= 24 THEN weekly_sales ELSE 0 END) as before_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number >= 26 THEN weekly_sales ELSE 0 END) as after_sales
    FROM week_totals
    GROUP BY region
),
platform_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        platform,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number <= 24 THEN weekly_sales ELSE 0 END) as before_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number >= 26 THEN weekly_sales ELSE 0 END) as after_sales
    FROM week_totals
    GROUP BY platform
),
age_band_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        age_band,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number <= 24 THEN weekly_sales ELSE 0 END) as before_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number >= 26 THEN weekly_sales ELSE 0 END) as after_sales
    FROM week_totals
    GROUP BY age_band
),
demographic_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        demographic,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number <= 24 THEN weekly_sales ELSE 0 END) as before_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number >= 26 THEN weekly_sales ELSE 0 END) as after_sales
    FROM week_totals
    GROUP BY demographic
),
customer_type_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_type,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number <= 24 THEN weekly_sales ELSE 0 END) as before_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN week_number >= 26 THEN weekly_sales ELSE 0 END) as after_sales
    FROM week_totals
    GROUP BY customer_type
),
region_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        (after_sales - before_sales) * 1.0 / NULLIF(before_sales, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM region_summary
),
platform_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        platform,
        (after_sales - before_sales) * 1.0 / NULLIF(before_sales, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM platform_summary
),
age_band_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        age_band,
        (after_sales - before_sales) * 1.0 / NULLIF(before_sales, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM age_band_summary
),
demographic_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        demographic,
        (after_sales - before_sales) * 1.0 / NULLIF(before_sales, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM demographic_summary
),
customer_type_pct_change AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_type,
        (after_sales - before_sales) * 1.0 / NULLIF(before_sales, 0) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM customer_type_summary
)
SELECT 
    'region' as attribute_type,
    ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 4) as avg_pct_change
FROM region_pct_change
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'platform' as attribute_type,
    ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 4) as avg_pct_change
FROM platform_pct_change
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'age_band' as attribute_type,
    ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 4) as avg_pct_change
FROM age_band_pct_change
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'demographic' as attribute_type,
    ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 4) as avg_pct_change
FROM demographic_pct_change
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'customer_type' as attribute_type,
    ROUND(AVG(pct_change), 4) as avg_pct_change
FROM customer_type_pct_change
ORDER BY avg_pct_change
